title: MyST page frontmatter v1.10
description: The page-level MyST frontmatter fields, as of mystmd 1.10. MyST requires nothing: a page with no `title` takes one from its first heading. What this schema does carry is MyST's documented length caps — 500 characters on `title`, `subtitle`, `description` and `label`, 40 on `short_title` and `subject` — which are the constraints a long title silently violates. Project-level keys that belong in `myst.yml` (`bibliography`, `references`, `requirements`, `social`) are not described here; they are tolerated like any unknown key. Controlled vocabularies MyST defines but this schema does not reproduce — the 14 CRediT contributor roles above all — are checked for shape only, never against a transcribed list. See https://mystmd.org/guide/frontmatter

person.description: An author, editor or reviewer: an object, or a string referencing one declared elsewhere by id.

name.description: Full name, or a CSL-JSON object of parsed name parts.

corresponding.description: Marks the corresponding author. MyST requires an `email` alongside it.

roles.description: CRediT contributor roles. Checked as strings only — the 14-term vocabulary and its aliases are not transcribed here, so a guessed enum cannot reject a valid role.

title.description: Page title. When absent, MyST lifts it from the first heading and removes that heading from the content.

subtitle.description: Complementary title text shown beneath the title.

short_title.description: Abbreviated title for running headers and navigation. Capped at 40 characters.

description.description: Summary of the page, used for previews and indexing.

label.description: Identifier this page can be cross-referenced by.

subject.description: Short subject categorization. Capped at 40 characters.

date.description: Publication date. MyST accepts ISO 8601 (`2026-08-23`) and RFC 2822 variants (`23 Aug 2026`), so this is not constrained to one format.

keywords.description: Key concepts described by the page.

affiliations.description: Institutions referenced by `authors`, declared inline or by id.

license.description: An SPDX identifier such as `CC-BY-4.0`, or an object describing content and code licenses separately.

doi.description: A DOI, bare or as a URL.

pmcid.description: A PubMed Central id: the literal `PMC` followed by digits.

kernelspec.description: Jupyter kernel this page executes against.

math.description: Macro dictionary applied to math on this page.
